title: Shared definitions — Utopia Homes Business Contract guest.answer@1.0 RC2
$comment: Encodes RC2 verbatim and nothing stricter. Every pattern here traces to an explicit RC2 clause; where RC2 left a field to a cross-field business invariant rather than wire syntax (e.g. URL hostname approval), this file does not attempt to encode that invariant as a schema pattern.

uuidV4.$comment: RC2 §3: canonical lowercase RFC 4122 text form. Unlike the Management Contract, uppercase is NOT accepted here — RC2 states the canonical form explicitly.

subjectId.$comment: RC2 §9.1: null or a 1-64 character lowercase kebab-case identifier. No leading/trailing/consecutive hyphen (enforced by the +(?:-...)* shape, which cannot produce -- or a leading/trailing -).

normalizedPath.$comment: RC2 §9.1: at most 512 chars; no scheme, host, credentials, query string, fragment, encoded external URL, or percent-encoded delimiter that would introduce a query string or fragment. Encoded as: starts with a single '/' (not '//', which would be protocol-relative), contains none of ? # : @ literally, and contains no %3f/%3F (encoded ?) or %23 (encoded #) anywhere.

locale.$comment: RC2 §9.1: exactly en-US in v1.0. Additional locales require explicit capability negotiation, not a wider pattern here.

messageContent.$comment: RC2 §9.1: message.content, after trimming, is 1-2000 Unicode scalar values.

historyEntryContent.$comment: RC2 §9.1: no explicit per-entry bound is stated beyond the 10,000-character total across history (enforced as a cross-field invariant, not here) and message.content's 1-2000 bound for the current message. A history entry's content is therefore only bounded to be a non-empty string here; the 10,000-character aggregate is I-B01.

historyRole.$comment: RC2 §9.1: only user and assistant. system/developer/tool/unknown are rejected.

namespacedId.$comment: RC2 §12.2: source_id and action_id. Exactly one colon; namespace 1-32 chars, local identifier 1-95 chars, complete identifier 3-128 chars; both components lowercase kebab-case with no leading/trailing/consecutive hyphen; no additional colons. The two lookaheads enforce the 32/95 sub-bounds directly (the overall 3-128 bound follows automatically: 1+1+1 <= total <= 32+1+95); minLength/maxLength below are a redundant belt-and-suspenders check of that overall bound.

displayText.$comment: RC2 §12.2: a customer-visible plain-text field. Base type only; callers apply the field-specific minLength/maxLength (title 1-120, label 1-80, limitation 1-240, answer 1-4000).

httpsUrl.$comment: RC2 §12.2: HTTPS only, at most 2048 chars, no user-info, no fragment. Query strings ARE allowed here (unlike request page_context.path) — an external booking destination may legitimately carry query parameters. Encoded as: https:// scheme; the authority component (up to the first '/') contains no '@' (no user-info); the whole value contains no '#' (no fragment).

releaseId.$comment: RC2 §12.2: X-Utopia-Business-Release / X-Utopia-Knowledge-Release. 1-128 visible ASCII characters, no whitespace.

actionKind.$comment: RC2 §12.2: v1.0 permits exactly these three.
